House of Barbaard is an immersive experience that is much more than just a haircut.
Mar 2026 • Solo
Staying at the Sofitel Saigon Plaza and in need of haircut before returning to work back in Australia and spotted House of Barbaard in our hotel. Was fortunate to get an appointment and so happy I did. 

House of Barbaard Is much more than a barber shop, it is an immersive experience that felt luxurious and exclusive. From reception to barber shop then into the bar to relax, it was an amazing few hours. 

I was fortunate to have Tai, “The Zookeeper” attend to my hair cut needs. Tai asked what I wanted to achieve and was meticulously attentive to achieve what I was looking for. Haircut, hot towels, wash and conversation were all first class. 

Sitting in the bar afterwards enjoying one of their many good whiskies, I felt so released and satisfied that I found myself wishing I needed another haircut before I head back home. 

Highly recommend House of Barbaard and Tai if you are looking for much more than your average barbershop experience.

Best drink experience in Saigon.
Aug 2024 • Couples
We love a great secret hidden cocktail bar and this doesn’t disappoint.
Tucked away on the 3rd floor of the Sofitel this is an absolute gem for a spectacular immersive and interactive cocktail experience. 
Staff welcomed us (in particular Zane who was a master alchemist) 
A cozy bar with chesterfield seats around three tables in the main bar and a members private VIP area to the side.
Drinks explained on an I-Pad give you the details of each cocktail and then sit back to watch them being prepared and with spectacular theatrical flair they are delivered to you.
This bar has to rate up there with the top cocktail bars we’ve ever visited.
